notes: Most JHU programme and admissions sites (engineering, carey, sais, education, krieger, department sites) disallow our crawler in robots.txt or sit behind a Cloudflare challenge, and publichealth.jhu.edu returned HTTP 403, so none were fetched. Requirements come from the official academic catalogue (e-catalogue.jhu.edu), cs.jhu.edu and peabody.jhu.edu. Catalogue programme pages rarely state admission requirements, so many programmes carry empty fields and are queued for a human. Carey scores and the School of Education GPA/English minimums come from each school's own catalogue admission policy, which the programme pages do not link to explicitly; Carey scores are labelled preferred minimums. Deadlines are omitted because no source quote states a year. Part-time, online and Engineering for Professionals programmes, Peabody MM specialisations and all other Krieger/SAIS/Bloomberg programmes were not collected one by one.
